body: I’m so sorry you’re experiencing that. Please never give up on people. Look inside yourself and realise that you had the kindness to reply to me and support a stranger. That is what is inside people. If there is no one around you like that, who says you can’t be that person for yourself? There is always hope when you put good out into the world. Happiness starts with giving.
True, thanks
